title: Unusual God Happenings That Change Everything
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares incredible stories of spiritual warfare, miraculous healings, and divine interventions that are changing lives and communities. You'll be challenged to step out of your comfort zone and into the unknown, where God is waiting to unleash His power and do the impossible. From trampled by an elephant to encountering witch doctors and demonic forces, Pastor Chris will take you on a journey that will shake you up and ignite a hunger for the supernatural in your life.
